chunks: "O Lord," he prayed, "I have done wrong, forgive me." And God forgave him. Verily He is forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the verse where God says 'I have wronged myself, so forgive me'?
ai.summary: While often associated with Prophet Musa (Moses) in the context of the Exodus narrative, this verse is also cited by Shia exegetes as a model of *tawbah* (repentance) applicable to all believers, emphasizing that sin is primarily a self-inflicted wrong (*dhulm al-nafs*). It underscores the immediate efficacy of sincere confession, linking human accountability directly to the divine attributes of *Al-Ghafur* (The All-Forgiving) and *Al-Rahim* (The Merciful). This supplication serves as a foundational template for the Shia practice of seeking forgiveness through direct, humble appeal to God's boundless mercy.
